title: establish-conditional-acceptance-protocol-for-phased-prd-dependencies
creator: Jordan Alvarez
description:
Problem: PRD approval is frequently delayed when acceptance requires outputs from other teams (legal contract language, design accessibility notes, infra capacity signoff). This ticket defines a conditional acceptance protocol so a PRD can progress through signoff lanes with verifiable artifacts and clear fallbacks instead of blocking the entire release.

Objectives:
- Define 'conditional acceptance' lanes where PRD is accepted with specified dependent artifacts due before rollout or within a timeboxed remediation window.
- Formalize artifact types and verification steps (legal memo, design handoff, infra runbook, e2e test results).
- Create an acceptance matrix describing which artifacts are required for Full Acceptance vs Conditional Acceptance vs Deferred Acceptance.
- Assign owners and SLAs for dependent artifacts and document fallback releases (feature flag gating, staged region rollout).
- Implement light-weight automation: signoff checklist template in Confluence, Slack workflow to capture approvals, and webhook to update Linear status when dependencies are closed.

Why this matters: reduces end-to-end PRD latency, gives engineering predictable timelines to implement fallbacks, and provides legal/design with clear artifact expectations and timelines.
acceptance_criteria: A tested acceptance matrix exists in Confluence describing Full / Conditional / Deferred lanes and the artifact types required for each lane.
Each conditional lane has a named owner (team + owner) and a SLA (business days) recorded in the PRD template.
A Confluence signoff template and checklist is created and linked from PRD templates; template auto-populates dependency list from PRD metadata.
Automation: Slack signoff workflow posts approvals; a webhook updates this Linear ticket's labels and moves status to 'In Review' when all mandatory items are complete.
Fallback playbook documented: feature-flagging instructions, region/tenant rollout plan, and rollback criteria are included in PRD when Conditional Acceptance is chosen.
At least two pilot PRDs use the protocol and complete signoff within target SLA during the pilot window (measurements captured).
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created after postmortem flagged multiple PRDs blocked waiting on legal wording. Draft protocol proposed.
2025-02-21: Alignment sync w/Design (Maya Chen) and Legal (Ethan Brooks). Legal requested explicit artifact checklist and template language for risk acceptance.
2025-02-26: Engineering (Liam O'Rourke) proposed two fallback patterns: (1) soft rollout behind feature flag, (2) limited-capacity region canary. Added to matrix.
2025-03-01: Built initial Confluence signoff checklist; prototype Slack workflow drafted (bot posts when PRD moves to 'Ready for signoff').
2025-03-03: PM review with Head of Platform. Agreed to pilot with two PRDs targeting runtime-1.20 release window. Requested automation owner and telemetry plan.
2025-03-05: Legal provided wording for Conditional Acceptance memo and approved the artifact templates. Design flagged accessibility checklist as mandatory for Full Acceptance.
notes_for_engineering: Engineering to provide playbook snippets for feature-flag rollout and a minimal canary orchestration runbook. Estimate ~3 days of eng time for automation webhook + Linear integration. Keep the initial pilot low-friction: manual verification allowed for first two PRDs to validate process.
notes_for_legal: Legal to supply conditional acceptance memo template and required phrasing for risk acceptance. Identify decisions that cannot be deferred and must block Full Acceptance (e.g., export controls).
pilot_plan: Pilot with: (1) PRD: structured-output-v2 (owner: Priya Patel) and (2) PRD: dedicated-autoscale-slo (owner: Jordan Alvarez). Two-week pilot window starting 2025-03-10. Collect signoff times and any runway slippage reasons.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Teams treat Conditional Acceptance as 'low-effort' and skip artifacts. Mitigation: make checklist required field in PRD creation flow and require owner acknowledgment in Slack workflow.
Risk: Automation bugs incorrectly move tickets. Mitigation: include a manual review step and webhook dry-run during pilot.
Risk: Legal may still require Full Acceptance for regulated customers. Mitigation: carve out 'Regulated Customer' clause in matrix; require Full Acceptance for those cases.
